nodes.description: Private owner address; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the sole authorization gate for privileged functions.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spender allowances, decremented in transferFrom and set in approve.
Private whitelist mapping; addresses flagged here bypass the transfer restriction logic in ensure().
Per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom and compared against _saleNum in condition().
Minimum allowed transfer amount in base units, configured by the owner via init().
Maximum allowed transfer amount in base units, configured by the owner via init().
Global sale quota per address, configured by the owner via init().
Owner-controlled address that is whitelisted inside ensure(); set through setTradeAddress().
Total token supply, minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Constant 18 decimals used as a scaling factor in the constructor, init() and _mints().
Token name set from the constructor parameter.
Token symbol set from the constructor parameter.
Payable external transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Main transfer routine: allowance check, ensure() whitelist check, then unchecked balance/allowance mutation and Transfer event.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] to an arbitrary value with no return-value validation.
Whitelist gate that returns true for owner, the hardcoded UNI router, the computed Uniswap pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise delegates to condition().
Enforces sale-count and min/max sale amount restrictions; used to block non-whitelisted sellers.
Owner-only function that performs a delegatecall to an arbitrary address with an arbitrary payload, giving the owner full control over contract storage.
Privileged mint routine that overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue * 10**decimals without SafeMath, and flips canSale[spender] to true.
Owner-only configuration of _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale using raw multiplication by 10**decimals.
Owner-only batch distribution that computes total = _value * _tos.length and mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic in a loop.
Owner-only setter that assigns an arbitrary address to the whitelisted tradeAddress state variable.
Pure helper that deterministically derives the Uniswap V2 pair address for this token, used inside ensure().
Payable constructor that sets metadata, mints the entire supply to msg.sender, and grants an infinite allowance to the hardcoded UNI router.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, beneficiary of transfers and storage writes throughout the contract.
Arbitrary delegatecall in delegate() to a caller-supplied address with caller-supplied calldata, executable by owner only.
Raw subtraction of allowance[_from][msg.sender] and balanceOf[_from] in transferFrom without SafeMath or underflow protection.
Unchecked multiplication addedValue * (10**uint256(decimals)) in _mints, which can overflow and assign an arbitrary balance.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length and unchecked balance additions/subtractions inside batchSend's loop.
Low-level address(token).call(data) inside SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn performing an external call with only a post-hoc success require.
Source address argument of transferFrom.
Destination address argument of transferFrom.
Amount argument of transferFrom, used in allowance and balance arithmetic.
Spender address argument of approve.
Sale quota argument written into _saleNum.
Minimum sale amount argument scaled into _minSale.
Maximum sale amount argument scaled into _maxSale.
Array of recipient addresses used in batchSend.
Per-recipient amount argument of batchSend.
New whitelisted trade address supplied by the owner.
Target address of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Calldata payload of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Address whose balance is overwritten by _mints.
Raw amount multiplied by 10**decimals when minting.
Token name supplied at deployment.
Token symbol supplied at deployment.
Initial supply multiplier scaled by 10**decimals.
Local variable holding _value * _tos.length, computed without overflow protection.
Loop index iterating over the recipient array.
Loop-local recipient address extracted from _tos.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
_from parameter controls which balance and allowance are read and written.
_to parameter receives the transferred balance.
_value parameter drives all balance and allowance mutations.
User-supplied _value flows into the unchecked allowance subtraction.
Unchecked subtraction writes the new balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] values.
transferFrom() executes raw subtraction on allowances and balances with no SafeMath.
_from is checked against the owner, UNI, pair and canSale whitelists inside ensure().
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
ensure() falls back to condition() when the caller is not whitelisted.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address used in the whitelist.
Owner-controlled tradeAddress grants a whitelist bypass in ensure().
The owner address always bypasses all transfer restrictions in ensure().
canSale[address] whitelist flags bypass the ensure() restrictions.
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared to _saleNum to limit sales per address.
_minSale bounds the minimum transferable amount in condition().
_maxSale bounds the maximum transferable amount in condition().
_saleNum is the per-address selling quota enforced by condition().
delegate() authorizes the caller against the stored owner address.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall after the owner check.
Caller-supplied address a becomes the delegatecall target, allowing arbitrary code execution in this contract's storage context.
Caller-supplied bytes b become the delegatecall payload.
The delegatecall can re-enter externally callable token functions (e.g. transfer/transferFrom) with full storage control.
_mints() authorizes msg.sender against the owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
_mints() performs an unchecked multiplication before writing balances.
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals with no overflow guard.
The unchecked product overwrites balanceOf[spender] and flips canSale[spender].
init() is restricted to the stored owner address.
init() writes the saleNum argument into _saleNum.
init() scales token by 10**decimals and stores it as _minSale.
init() scales maxToken by 10**decimals and stores it as _maxSale.
batchSend() is restricted to the owner, who can move tokens to arbitrary addresses.
_tos determines the recipients iterated over in the batch loop.
batchSend() computes totals and mutates balances with raw arithmetic.
_value feeds the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation.
The local total variable is computed without overflow protection and subtracted from the caller's balance.
Unchecked additions/subtractions update balanceOf for the sender and each recipient.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender to be the owner.
The owner can whitelist any arbitrary address as tradeAddress, bypassing transfer restrictions.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the deployer.
_supply is scaled by 10**decimals and assigned to totalSupply.
The constructor establishes the privileged owner account.
_name is stored into the name state variable.
_symbol is stored into the symbol state variable.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
approve() writes an arbitrary allowance value for msg.sender and the spender.
transferFrom() reads and rewrites balanceOf for both parties involved in the transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter only exists to select the balance/allowance slot mutated by transferFrom.
The _to parameter is only a destination index used by the transferFrom balance updates.
The _value parameter is the user-controlled amount consumed by the unchecked subtraction.
The _spender parameter is only the allowance key written by approve.
saleNum is a configuration argument assigned to _saleNum inside init.
token is a configuration argument scaled into _minSale inside init.
maxToken is a configuration argument scaled into _maxSale inside init.
_tos is only the recipient array iterated by the batchSend loop.
_value is the amount multiplied by _tos.length in the unchecked total computation.
addr is only the value written into the whitelisted tradeAddress slot.
a is the attacker-supplied target of the unsafe delegatecall.
b is the attacker-supplied calldata of the unsafe delegatecall.
spender is only the balance key overwritten by _mints.
addedValue is the multiplicand of the unchecked 10**decimals scaling.
_name is only deployment metadata stored in the name slot.
_symbol is only deployment metadata stored in the symbol slot.
_supply is only the initial mint quantity written to totalSupply.
total is the intermediate overflow-prone product used by batchSend's unchecked arithmetic.
i is only the loop counter of the batchSend distribution loop.
_to is only the per-iteration recipient alias inside batchSend.
